text.content: unit 8
Listening Consumer research
A Listen to a man answer survey questions in a grocery store. Number the
questions from 1 to 9 in the order you hear them.
Have your buying habits changed in the last year?
How often do you walk to the grocery store? All the time.
Doyou usuallyask for paper orplasticbags?
How much do you spend on groceries every month?
How many people are there in your household?
What is the highest level of education you've completed?
What do you do for a living?
Do you ever shop for groceries online?
How often do you buy environmentally friendly products?
Listen again. Write the man's answers.
C PAIR woRk Ask and answer the questions in Part A.Answer with your own
information, or avoid answering.
Speaking Do you waste water?
A Read the survey. Are there any questions you would avoid answering, or is there
any information you wouldn’t share?

How long do you spend in the shower?

Do you wash dishes by hand or do you use a dishwasher?
When you wash dishes, do you leave the water running?
When you wash clothes, is the washing machine always completely full?
Do you flush the toilet after every use?
B Interview your partner. Complete the survey with his or her answers.
Mark an x if he or she avoids answering.
PAiR wORK Compare your answers. Who uses more water? How could you use
